description: Clean5144 edge-relation ablation matrix. This is the paper-facing clean5144 GNN ablation family. Rules-only E2E relation-source controls are run separately by scripts/pipeline/run_clean5144_with_rules_ablation_suite.py because they do not train or load a GNN checkpoint.

experiments.name: M06_current_main_merge_gate
experiments.hypothesis: The current clean5144 main model balances MERGE and PARENT_CHILD quality with a Y-network, type-aware propagation, and hard MERGE gate.
experiments.purpose: Main model. The suite runner reuses the already trained clean5144 checkpoint instead of retraining it.

experiments.name: M05_no_merge_gate
experiments.hypothesis: Removing the MERGE gate should increase unsafe MERGE candidates and reduce production safety.
experiments.purpose: Y-network + type-aware propagation without class-specific MERGE suppression.

experiments.name: M07_gaussian_edge_feature
experiments.hypothesis: Gaussian proximity provides an additional physical locality cue for the PARENT/NONE branch.
experiments.purpose: Main model plus runtime gaussian proximity derived from center_distance.

experiments.name: A00_old_shared_gat
experiments.hypothesis: The old shared-head GAT underperforms because MERGE and PARENT_CHILD need different information paths.

experiments.name: A01_no_message_passing
experiments.hypothesis: Removing message passing should protect local MERGE features but weaken hierarchy decisions.
experiments.purpose: Learned edge classifier from projected local node/edge features only. This is not a no-GNN-rendering baseline; see R00/R01 E2E controls.

experiments.name: A02_no_type_aware_message_mask
experiments.hypothesis: Unrestricted propagation should increase pollution from float/table/noise nodes.
experiments.purpose: Current Y-network with unrestricted message propagation.

experiments.name: F00_no_scibert
experiments.hypothesis: Without SciBERT, semantic continuation and ambiguous local attachment should degrade.

experiments.name: F01_no_geometry_layout
experiments.hypothesis: Without geometry/layout features, column, float, and hierarchy cues should degrade.
experiments.purpose: Keep semantic/type cues and remove most layout evidence.

experiments.name: F02_no_v7_reading_flow
experiments.hypothesis: Removing repaired v7 reading-flow cues should reveal the value of band/column flow reconstruction.
experiments.purpose: Remove sequence, scroll, column, layout-layer, flow-context and matching edge flow cues.

experiments.name: E00_no_punctuation
experiments.hypothesis: Terminal punctuation and hyphen probes are important MERGE boundary cues.
experiments.purpose: Remove source punctuation and hyphen edge probes.

experiments.name: E01_no_gutter_overlap
experiments.hypothesis: Y-overlap and gutter cues suppress cross-column false MERGE.
experiments.purpose: Remove y-overlap and x-gutter edge features.

experiments.name: T00_no_ohem
experiments.hypothesis: Without OHEM, the long-tail NONE distribution should wash out positive relations.
experiments.purpose: Current model trained with ordinary weighted CE only.
